disclaimer: Rankings follow U.S. News Best National Universities for the year listed. An essay is one part of a holistic review. Nobody can guarantee an admission, and anyone who does is selling something.
methodologyHeading: Honest admissions guidance, zero manufactured guarantees
methodologyText: Admissions decisions are made through holistic review, where GPA, course rigor, testing, extracurricular impact, and recommendations intersect. Evergreen does not make inflated statistical claims or promise admission to specific institutions. What Andrea provides is uncompromising editorial precision, school list strategy, and authentic essay coaching that enables students to present their strongest, most compelling selves to admissions committees.
localDiscoveryText: Andrea advises students locally in New Canaan, across Fairfield County, and nationwide through comprehensive packages and per-school coaching.
ctaLede: Tell Andrea where your child is applying and where you are in the application timeline. Andrea will reply personally.
